What is your favorite Ghibli film and why?

My favorite film is Only Yesterday. I was lucky enough to see it at a small theater in New Mexico a couple years back. The movie is my favorite for a few reasons. First because it is different than the majority of Studio Ghibli films. I like that is shows what life is like in japan. Second, and more importantly, it is my favorite film because of the circumstances that led to me seeing it. I was on vacation with my ex, and we had been going through some rough times, I had been dealing with some medical issues, and that vacation was the perfect escape We went to this small art center on a whim and they were showing that movie as part of a Ghibli film series that was touring the country at the time. It was on our last day of vacation, and it brought such a smile to my face. I am hoping to get a region free dvd player soon so that I can get my hands on a copy of that movie.
Haven't seen them all yet. But so far Only Yesterday.
